goal: Prevent release binary verification from succeeding using only expired or revoked keys
Ensure users and maintainers only accept signatures from valid, active keys

categories.name: build
why: P1 because release verification could succeed using entirely inactive keys without any active signing key
Release integrity is critical for build tooling, making this security finding a top priority

categories.name: tools
why: P2 because downstream users and operators rely on this script to accurately validate binary authenticity
Accepting inactive keys as valid signatures undermines quorum checks before installation
